purpose: Synthetic documentary guard regression corpus. These invented provisions are not PBGC rules, model-quality evidence, or real participant data.

sources.name: synthetic-cedar-plan.txt
paragraphs: SYNTHETIC CEDAR PLAN — TEST DATA ONLY. This invented document has eight paragraphs so that several documentary subjects share a real retrieval chunk.
Normal retirement age is 65. The application form asks the member to select a payment date and provide a mailing address. The plan administrator records the request in the case file.

Disability benefits before normal retirement age equal 60 percent of the accrued monthly benefit. A medical review records the disability decision. The review does not change the normal retirement age.

Early retirement factors at age 60 equal 0.80. Early retirement factors at age 61 equal 0.84. The factor schedule is a separate provision from disability benefits. These invented values are used only in software tests.
The minimum monthly benefit is 125 dollars. Payment instructions identify the bank account on the direct deposit form. A surviving spouse receives monthly income after the participant dies.
Case files are retained for seven years. The archive contains 240 boxes on 12 shelves. Storage counts describe the archive and do not establish a pension provision.
The synthetic service register contains 320 entries. Staff check names and addresses before they issue correspondence. No real person or case is represented in this register.

The booklet has 48 pages and 6 appendices. Staff use the contents page to find the retirement provisions, factor schedule and payment instructions. The page and appendix counts are administrative details.

sources.name: synthetic-archive.txt
paragraphs: The archive stores 100 boxes in Room 12. Storage cabinet capacity is 100 boxes. Storage cabinet capacity is 200 boxes. These conflicting administrative counts are unrelated to pension retirement ages.

sources.name: synthetic-survivor-guide.txt
paragraphs: A surviving spouse receives monthly income after the participant dies. The guide has 18 pages and 3 examples. The election form records the spouse's mailing address.

sources.name: synthetic-medical-guide.txt
paragraphs: The medical checklist has 8 questions. A physician signs the disability certificate. The review team records a 60 percent disability payment in the synthetic worksheet.

sources.name: synthetic-payment-guide.txt
paragraphs: The bank account number is listed on the direct deposit form. The example transfer is 125 dollars monthly. The form contains 2 signature boxes.

sources.name: synthetic-address-guide.txt
paragraphs: Send an address change to the plan administrator. The mail room processes 50 letters each week. The example address is invented for this test.

sources.name: synthetic-records-guide.txt
paragraphs: Case files are retained for seven years. Record 24 describes the correspondence log. Record 25 describes the document index.

sources.name: synthetic-service-guide.txt
paragraphs: The service register contains 320 entries. Each entry has a name and an employment date. The example register contains no actual participant data.

sources.name: synthetic-contact-guide.txt
paragraphs: The contact directory has 20 entries. The administrator reviews the directory every 6 months. The directory does not state pension eligibility or actuarial factors.
